test_plan.scope: Validate FR-057..FR-070 (stepper, segmented severity, chip-preset cooldown, range single-source-of-truth, toggle, backup sub-divisions, anchor-chip+accordion, time picker, form-state pill, number-badge removal, Logout move, encryption-key probe, English-only copy, form widths) plus NFR-027..NFR-032 (perf, chip-click latency, backwards-compat POST, a11y, no new deps, probe privacy).
test_plan.approach: Three-layer pyramid. Unit tests pin the range constants (settings_ranges.go) and the probe handler. Integration tests exercise the rendered /settings HTML through goquery, asserting widget markup, label hint substrings, sub-section headings, removal of number badges, and absence of Logout in System Controls. e2e tests use Playwright against a built test binary with seeded SQLite to drive: (a) anchor-chip click → scrolled-and-expanded section, (b) stepper out-of-range typing → inline error, (c) severity segmented control 1-click selection, (d) encryption-key probe HTMX flow with valid + invalid env-var values, (e) Logout reachable from header dropdown across multiple pages. Security-sensitive probe TCs use golden-file equality on the JSON response shape.
fixtures: newTestServer(t) — starts an in-process httptest.Server with real handlers, real templates, real static FS, in-memory SQLite seeded with a fixed admin user (username=test, password-hash from bcrypt cost=4 for speed)
newTestSession(t, server) — POSTs to /login, returns a session cookie
seedAlertConfig(t, db, severity, threshold, cooldown) — inserts an alert rule for testing existing-value rendering
seedBackupConfig(t, db, hour, minute, schemeRef) — inserts a backup config row
envSet(t, k, v) — sets env var, t.Cleanup unsets
tempFile(t, mode) — writes a tmp file, returns path; t.Cleanup removes it (used for scheme=file probe)
playwrightCtx(t) — Playwright browser context with the test server URL and a logged-in storage state
test_plan.exit_criteria: All TCs pass; goquery integration tests confirm zero <select name="severity">, zero number-badge markup, zero `Ajust|Expandir|contraer` substrings on /settings; probe handler golden-file test passes; no new third-party Go or JS dependency added (verified by `go list -m all` diff and `git diff --stat web/static/js/`).
